label: POST_HOC_HISTORICAL_RESEARCH

partition.note: zile UTC ale CompleteEvent; deconectarile si segmentele trunchiate excluse (populatia master 946)

population: migrari BOOST cu istoric pre-migrare complet si evenimente post-migrare utilizabile (cache m_pools, 946 pool-uri, manifest sigilat d5a3c02a…)

execution.decision: T0 + 60 s dupa crearea pool-ului (T0 = CreatePoolEvent ts)
execution.entry: prima stare completa observabila (ancorata, fara schimbare ascunsa de rezerve) la sau dupa decizie, ordonare conservatoare (dupa toate evenimentele cu ts <= X)
execution.exit_primary: 60 s dupa intrarea reala (prima stare ancorata >= intrare+60 s, conservator)
execution.fees: schema observata validata (bps din evenimente; taxa 0 inlocuita cu resolver-ul de tiere/25-5-0)
execution.impact: propriu, exact, la intrare si iesire
constraints: starile cu schimbari de lichiditate neobservate (rupturi de lant) excluse
fara cautare de parametri sau orizonturi

H1_COHORT_ROTATION_V2.mechanism: cererea persista cand proprietatea se roteste de la participantii pre-migrare catre multi cumparatori noi, in timp ce cohorta vanzatorilor incumbenti scade

definitions.selective_new_buyer_quote_share: quote al cumparatorilor post-only cu selectivitate >= mediana DEV a numarului de mint-uri anterioare (mai putine = mai selectiv) / quote total de cumparare in [T0, D)
definitions.incumbent_sell_quote_share: quote vandut de cohorta pre-migrare / quote total (buy+sell) in [T0,D)
definitions.concentration_HHI: HHI al cotelor de quote de cumparare pe portofel in [T0,D)

H1_COHORT_ROTATION_V2.signal: cuartila superioara a distributiei DEV a rotation_score, cu >= 5 cumparatori post-only, >= 10 swap-uri post-migrare, istoric pre-migrare complet

H2_SELLER_OVERHANG_DECAY_V2.mechanism: pretul poate avansa doar dupa ce intensitatea vanzarilor cohortei pre-migrare scade si overhang-ul de inventar reconstruit nu mai este dominant

features.incumbent_sell_0_30: quote vandut de incumbenti in secundele 0-30
features.incumbent_sell_30_60: quote vandut de incumbenti in secundele 30-60
features.remaining_inventory_proxy: INVENTORY_PROXY ramas al cohortei / inventarul total la T0
features.largest_incumbent_remaining_share: cea mai mare cota individuala ramasa / oferta pool-ului (proxy)

H2_SELLER_OVERHANG_DECAY_V2.signal: decay_ratio in cuartila DEV cea mai epuizata (cea mai mica) SI remaining_inventory_proxy sub mediana DEV; praguri distributionale, niciodata din PnL

H3_SELECTIVE_BUYER_QUALITY_V1.mechanism: cinci portofele noi care cumpara un token nu sunt echivalente cu cinci portofele care pulverizeaza sute de lansari
H3_SELECTIVE_BUYER_QUALITY_V1.feature: quality = media rangurilor DEV (egal ponderate) pentru: +new_buyer_breadth, -median_prior_mint_count al cumparatorilor post-only, -top_wallet_buy_flow_concentration
H3_SELECTIVE_BUYER_QUALITY_V1.signal: cuartila superioara a quality (ranguri DEV), cu >= 5 cumparatori post-only

statistics.bootstrap: 10.000 repetari deterministe, clustere mint x zi UTC
baselines: matched (lichiditate la decizie, randament anterior, numar de tranzactii, intensitate flux de cumparare)
